$comment: UI workflow evaluation cases. 'activation' cases run live through tests/ui-workflow/activation-eval.mjs (opt-in, costs model usage) and are checked structurally by tests/ui-workflow.test.mjs. 'behaviour' cases name the offline test that proves them. expect_any: at least one of these skills must load. forbid: none of these may load. A case with expect_any [] passes when no forbidden skill loads.

Build a new Bookings page that lists scheduled appointments with date and status filters, an empty state, and a link from each offer.
Redesign the model and effort pickers in the chat header so they look and behave like one consistent control.
Add a confirmation dialog before a chat is deleted. Remember we don't add packages.
On phones the offers list breaks in RTL: the price wraps under the title and the card overflows at 390px. Fix it.
Our spacing, radii and colours are inconsistent across components. Set up a proper token scale and dark mode on top of what we have.
Review index.html for accessibility and responsive problems before I ship it.
Write a Playwright end-to-end test for deleting a chat, including the confirmation step.
I need a visual direction for a landing page for a small coffee roaster: palette, type and one signature idea. Don't build anything yet.
Add an --ignore-case flag to the log-grep CLI.
Write an Alembic migration that adds an index on offers.price and a pytest that checks it exists.
